title: Implement lookup functions (gatt_to_ipso, gatt_service_to_ipso)
description:
Implement in gatt_ipso.c:

1. gatt_to_ipso(uint16_t gatt_uuid) - binary search or linear scan of characteristic table
2. gatt_service_to_ipso(uint16_t service_uuid) - lookup in service table

Both return const struct gatt_ipso_mapping* or NULL if not found.

Consider:
- Table must be sorted by UUID for binary search
- Compile-time assertion on table size
- Optional: count function for iteration

~30 LOC. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md
